name: Phoenix Welsh
description:
Rising from setbacks stronger than ever. A tribute to the resilient Welsh community and its innovative leader who keeps building despite the odds. Each token represents the spirit of grassroots innovation and community resilience.

"Innovation never dies, it just reborns stronger"
